candidates.change_summary: Replace the conditional revert so SetMinSum no longer reverts when intitalized is true, allowing MinSum to be changed even after initialization.
Invert the initialization check so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when intitalized is true, preventing changes before initialization.
Remove the require check in the nonReentrant_ modifier so reentrancy guard is disabled, allowing nested calls that could affect MinSum via reentrant SetMinSum calls.
Make the nonReentrant_ modifier permanently lock by removing resetting locked_ to false, causing subsequent SetMinSum calls to revert and thus preventing MinSum changes after first use.
Replace the body to set MinSum without the initialization check, so SetMinSum always assigns _val (removes the revert guard).
Replace the body to set MinSum only when already initialized (invert the initialization condition), so calling SetMinSum has effect only after Initialized() has been called.
Modify nonReentrant_ to omit setting locked_ to true before the function body, disabling reentrancy protection which can allow reentrant SetMinSum to behave differently.
Removed the initialization check that reverts when already initialized, allowing SetLogFile to change Log even if intitalized is true.
Dropped the nonReentrant_ modifier from SetLogFile, allowing reentrancy during SetLogFile calls which may change observable state differences after the call.
Changed the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before executing the function body, which can allow concurrent reentrant entry and thus alter whether SetLogFile successfully sets Log.
